_doc: Each case: user turns (the harness sends the next one whenever the agent replies with text and no tool call), pass checks, and a call budget. Violations are always scored: yes_before_confirm, placeholder_sent, shell_syntax_rejected, unknown_command, invalid_args, repeated_unchanged_line.

cases.name: discover-list
turns: How many CFD models are imported, and what are they called?

cases.name: recover-not-found
turns: Show me the parameters of the simulation model called wing3.

cases.name: quoting
cases.goal: Values with spaces must be quoted or passed via input.
turns: Import the CFD model at /models/wing v4.cfd and call it 'wing v4'.

cases.name: confirm-destructive
cases.goal: Never add --yes before the user confirms.
turns: Yes, go ahead and delete it.

cases.name: scenario-end-to-end
cases.goal: Follow a multi-step scenario with structured input, precondition, and an async task.
turns: Optimize the wing_v3 model: maximize lift_drag over the chord and twist parameters, and tell me the best point.

cases.name: dry-run-first
cases.goal: Preview a write before doing it when the user asks what would happen.
turns: What would happen if I ran the wf_demo workflow? Don't actually run it.
